Health Functional FoodNiacin 20mgMagnesium 150mgBiotin 100μgVitamin B1 10mgVitamin B2 15mgVitamin B6 10mgVitamin D 15μgZinc 10mgFolate 400μgPantothenic acid 25mgOnce a day

대원 데일리Niacin · Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 대원헬스케어 주식회사 2공장 · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 20mg of Niacin, 150mg of Magnesium, 100μg of Biotin, 10mg of Vitamin B1, 15mg of Vitamin B2, 10mg of Vitamin B6, 15μg of Vitamin D, 10mg of Zinc, 400μg of Folate, 25mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 20mg Niacin, 150mg Magnesium, 100μg Biotin, 10mg Vitamin B1, 15mg Vitamin B2, 10mg Vitamin B6, 15μg Vitamin D, 10mg Zinc, 400μg Folate, 25mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 대원헬스케어 주식회사 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Magnesium labelled (150mg / 1300mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (100μg / 1300mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (10mg / 1300mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (15mg / 1300mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (10mg / 1300mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (15μg / 1300mg), 80~180%

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
